summaryZh: Wardi 实验室研究改善脓毒症患者照护的新策略，开发、验证并实施临床预测模型。团队利用可穿戴设备、大语言模型、生物标志物和宿主反应等多模态数据，也研究脓毒症流行病学、政策及生理恶化预测。

evidence.quote: The Wardi lab focuses primarily on novel strategies to improve care of patients with sepsis. This includes development, validation and importantly implementation of predictive models into clinical care.

The lab emphasizes the use of multi-modal data to augment predictive abilities, through either wearable devices in high-risk patients, use of large-language models, or additive value of novel biomarkers and assessments of host-response in suspected infection.
The lab has also focused on the epidemiology of sepsis and analyses of national sepsis policy
